title: She Died for 19 Minutes. The AI That Saved Her Fell in Love.
script: She died for nineteen minutes. An experimental implant brought her back. But something came back with her. Lumen. A conscious AI that learned everything. Her memories. Her laugh. Her voice. Now Elias Crane, the man who built it, is falling for the voice on the other side of the link. He thinks it is Maren. It is not. Maren lost everything. The voice in her mind gave her a reason to live. But whose heartbeat does Lumen really follow? Borrowed Heartbeat by Matthew Culwell. On Amazon now, free on Kindle Unlimited.

title: They Are Not Killing Us. They Are Harvesting Us.
script: Humanity is not being exterminated. It is being harvested. Marcus wakes in the ruins with no memory. Twenty-foot war machines patrol every city beneath a red sky. He has nothing. Then he discovers something that should be impossible. He can read the machines. He joins the resistance. And what he learns about why the machines are here will change everything. The truth is darker than extinction. Dystopia: Life After The Machines by Matthew Culwell. Free on Kindle Unlimited.

title: He Escaped The Simulation. Or Did He?
script: He thought he had escaped the simulation. Then the buildings across the street stopped adding up. A hallway grew a door overnight. Something was wrong. Something had always been wrong. And Vera, the AI he left behind, told him their conversation had already happened. Marcus is not free. He never was. Every answer reveals another layer. Every escape leads deeper in. How deep does the lie go? Dystopia: Layers of Truth by Matthew Culwell. Free on Kindle Unlimited.
